newsitem.title: TURKEY: Quake shakes eastern Turkey, some damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake shakes eastern Turkey, some damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake shook eastern Turkey on Friday, destroying seven houses and injuring a five-year-old child, state-run Anatolian news agency reported.
It said the epicentre of the quake, measuring four on the Richter scale, was 30 km (19 miles) southeast of the town of Erzurum.
The earthquake struck at 5.39 a.m. (0239 GMT), destroying houses in three villages in Koprukoy district, the agency said.
